question_record.context: A recent security incident revealed that multiple dual-purpose tools, such as powershell.exe, psexec.exe, rubeus.exe, and domaindominance27.ps1, were dropped on the device. This indicates that attackers might have downloaded or copied these tools to the target device to perform various attack stages, including credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.
question_record.question: What is the command line and process ID associated with the execution of the tool used to detect the malicious credential theft?
solution: Multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped on the device with AadDeviceId `4d8d23e9-a77d-4e33-9435-b8c457e57ca1`.
A malicious credential theft tool was executed with the command line `mimikatz.exe privilege::debug sekurlsa::logonpasswords exit` at `2024-06-27t14:32:35.4061023z`, with Process ID `5196`.

76.name: Multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped
76.description:
Multiple known public tools, which could also be used for malicious reasons were dropped on this device.
Attackers might download or copy multiple dual-purpose tools to the target device to perform various attack stages including, credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.

89.name: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
89.description:
A known credential theft tool execution command line was detected.
Either the process itself or its command line indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords and more.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Device_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s,%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Device_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Process_Identity'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
